predictions.selection_reason: Default html:false configuration -> if changed to true by admin -> allows raw HTML in markdown rendering
predictions.source_summary: Configuration comes from admin settings via meta.settings.get('markdown') with defaults including 'html': false
predictions.sink_summary: Parser configuration flows to Remarkable markdown parser which renders user content via markdownify hook
predictions.guard_summary: Default configuration sets html:false; admin can change via settings but requires admin privileges
predictions.risk_pattern: Default html:false prevents raw HTML in markdown; if admin enables html:true, user-submitted markdown can contain arbitrary HTML leading to XSS
enclosing_conditions: Admin settings override mechanism in meta.settings.get callback
predictions.context_summary: The 'html' configuration controls whether Remarkable parser allows raw HTML in markdown. Default false prevents XSS; if admin enables, user content can execute arbitrary HTML/JS.
unresolved_facts: Specific Remarkable version and its exact HTML handling behavior
Whether NodeBB has additional HTML sanitization after markdown parsing

retrieval_query.mechanism_summary: Admin-accessible configuration option enables dangerous feature (raw HTML) that bypasses XSS protections
